Shilajit is a natural resin that forms over long periods in high-altitude mountain regions. Shilajit Store sources its resin from the Gilgit-Baltistan region of Pakistan — one of the same mountain systems known worldwide for producing this resin — and has it tested before it reaches you. What's In the box Himalayan/Gilgit-Baltistan shilajit resin Naturally occurring minerals, as found in raw shilajit No unnecessary additives How to Use Take a small, pea-sized amount (approx. 300–500mg) and dissolve it in warm water, milk, or tea. Typically taken once daily, generally in the morning. A Note on Claims We don't make specific health promises about what this product will do for you — everyone's body is different. What we can tell you clearly is where it's sourced from, what's in the jar, and that it's tested.
